Any resulting revised rendering requires fresh review.","severity":"blocking"}]},{"reference":"9.19","verdict":"revise","checks":{"complete_coverage":true,"no_added_claims":true,"names_and_negations":true,"lexical_fidelity":false,"uncertainties_disclosed":true},"findings":[{"source_quote":"οὐ μόνον τὰ ἐνδομυχοῦντα ὑμῖν πνεύματα ἀπελάσαι δυνήσεσθε, ἀλλ᾽ αὐτοὶ μηκέτι ἁμαρτάνοντες καὶ θεῷ ἀνενδοιάστως πιστεύοντες τὰ ἄλλων κακὰ πνεύματα καὶ δαιμόνια χαλεπὰ σὺν τοῖς δεινοῖς πάθεσιν ἀπελάσετε.","english_quote":"you will be able not only to drive away the spirits lurking in your innermost recesses, but also—if you yourselves no longer sin and believe God without wavering—to drive out other people’s evil spirits and fierce demons, together with their dreadful afflictions.","issue":"The draft places both expulsions under “you will be able.” The Greek distinguishes ability in the first member, ἀπελάσαι δυνήσεσθε, from a direct future assertion in the second, ἀπελάσετε, “you will drive out.” The shared English modal weakens the second assertion to capability and conceals this wording distinction.","suggested_revision":"Proposed wording for fresh review: “you will not only be able to drive away the spirits lurking in your innermost recesses, but—if you yourselves no longer sin and believe God without wavering—you will drive out other people’s evil spirits and fierce demons, together with their dreadful afflictions.”","severity":"major"}]},{"reference":"9.20","verdict":"accept","checks":{"complete_coverage":true,"no_added_claims":true,"names_and_negations":true,"lexical_fidelity":true,"uncertainties_disclosed":true},"findings":[]}]}
